paper_title: DLP Dynamic Layerwise Pruning in Large Language Models
caption: Perplexity of LLaMA1-7B on different validation datasets under varying quantization bits.

annotations.annotation: The series of bar charts illustrates the perplexity values associated with different quantization bits for three datasets: WikiText, PTB, and C4. Each chart has the horizontal axis labeled as "Quantization Bits," displaying the categories in increasing order as 3, 4, 8, and 16. The vertical axis for each chart is labeled "Perplexity," with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 400 on the second chart and up to 30 on the first and third charts, with numerical tick intervals of 50 in the second chart and 5 in the first and third charts respectively. In each chart, the bars are grouped in pairs for each quantization bit category; the first bar of each pair is labeled "Uniform" and is colored blue, while the second bar is labeled "Ours" and is colored orange. In the WikiText chart, the height of the "Uniform" bars approximately ranges from 26 to 31, whereas the "Ours" bars range from 17 to 22. In the PTB chart, "Uniform" bars span approximately from 300 to 420, while "Ours" bars range from around 160 to 240. In the C4 chart, "Uniform" bars are approximately between 24 and 30, and "Ours" bars range from 17 to 20. The bars within each chart are consistently arranged by category for comparison without any specific sorting. A legend is present in top-left each chart, clarifying the colors associated with "Uniform" and "Ours". There is no particular emphasis or annotation on any individual bar in the charts.

The series of bar charts illustrates the perplexity values associated with different quantization bits for three different datasets: WikiText, PTB, and C4. Each chart has the horizontal axis labeled as "Quantization Bits," represented in the categories in increasing order as 3, 4, 8, and 16. The vertical axis for each chart is labeled "Perplexity," with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30 in first and third plot (WikiText and C4 dataset) and 0 to 400 in PTB dataset chart. In each chart, the bars are grouped in pairs for each quantization bit category; the first bar of each pair is labeled "Uniform" and is colored blue, while the second bar is labeled "Ours" and is colored orange. These represented the two sparsity levels: Uniform and papers (DLP pruned sparsity) respectively. In the WikiText chart, the height of the "Uniform" bars approximately ranges from 25 to 31 , whereas the "Ours" bars range from 16 to 21. In the PTB chart, "Uniform" bars span approximately from 300 to 400, while "Ours" bars range from around 100 to 240 approximately. In the C4 chart, "Uniform" bars are approximately between 24 and 30, and "Ours" bars range from 16 to 20. The bars within each chart are consistently arranged by category for comparison without any specific sorting. However, in each of the dataset, perplexity is decreasing as quantization bits increasing. A legend is present in top left of each chart, clarifying the colors associated with "Uniform" and "Ours."

Die Balkendiagrammreihe veranschaulicht die Perplexitätswerte verschiedener Quantisierungsbits für drei Datensätze: (a) WikiText, (b) PTB und (c) C4. Die horizontale Achse jedes Diagramms ist mit "Quantization Bits" gekennzeichnet und hat die Werte 3, 4, 8 und 16. Die vertikale Achse jedes Diagramms trägt die Bezeichnung "Perplexity" und ist linear skaliert. Im zweiten Diagramm reicht die Skala von 0 bis 400, im ersten und dritten Diagramm von 0 bis 30. Die Teilstrichintervalle betragen im ersten 50 und im ersten und dritten 5. In jedem Diagramm sind die Balken für jede Quantisierungsbitkategorie paarweise gruppiert. Der erste Balken jedes Paars trägt die Bezeichnung "Uniform" und ist blau, der zweite trägt die Bezeichnung "Ours" und ist orange. Dies ist in der Legende in der oberen linken Ecke jedes Diagrammes erkennbar. Im Wiki-Text-Diagramm beträgt die Höhe der "Uniform"-Balken etwa 25 bis 30, während die der "Ours"-Balken zwischen 15 und 20 liegen. Im PTB-Diagramm sind die "Uniform"-Balken etwas 300 bis 400 hoch, während die der "Ours"-Balken zwischen etwa 100 und 200 liegen. Im C4-Diagramm liegen die "Uniform"-Balken etwa zwischen 20 und 30, die "Ours" Balken zwischen 10 und 20.

Серията от стълбовидни диаграми илюстрира стойностите на перплекситета при различни нива на квантуване (в битове) за три набора от данни: (a) WikiText, (b) PTB и (c) C4. Хоризонталната ос на всяка диаграма е означена като „Квантови битове“ и включва стойности 3, 4, 8 и 16. Вертикалната ос е означена като „Перплекситет“ и е с линейна скала. В диаграмата за PTB скалата е от 0 до 400 с интервали през 50 единици, докато при WikiText и C4 тя варира от 0 до 30 с интервали през 5. За всяка стойност на квантовите битове са представени по две стълбчета: първото (в синьо) обозначава резултатите на „Униформения“(Uniform) метод, а второто (в оранжево) на „Нашия“ (Our) подход. Това разграничение е визуализирано в легендата в горния ляв ъгъл на всяка диаграма. При WikiText, стойностите за „Униформения“ метод са в диапазона 25–30, докато тези на нашия подход - между 15 и 20. При PTB, съответно между 300–400 и 100–200, а при C4, между 20–30 и 10–20. Данните показват, че предложеният от нас метод води до значително по-нисък перплекситет при всички изследвани случаи.

The series of bar charts illustrates the perplexity values associated with different quantization bits for three datasets: WikiText, PTB, and C4. Each chart has the horizontal axis labeled as "Quantization Bits," displaying the categories in increasing order as 3, 4, 8, and 16. The vertical axis for each chart is labeled "Perplexity," with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 400 on the second chart and up to 30 on the first and third charts, with numerical tick intervals of 50 and 5 respectively. In each chart, the bars are grouped in pairs for each quantization bit category; the first bar of each pair is labeled "Uniform" and is colored blue, while the second bar is labeled "Ours" and is colored orange. In the WikiText chart, the height of the "Uniform" bars approximately ranges from 26 to 31, whereas the "Ours" bars range from 18 to 22. In the PTB chart, "Uniform" bars span approximately from 290 to 430, while "Ours" bars range from around 170 to 240. In the C4 chart, "Uniform" bars span between 24 and 30, and "Ours" bars range from 17 to 21. The bars within each chart are consistently arranged by category for comparison without any specific sorting. A legend is present in each chart, clarifying the colors associated with "Uniform" and "Ours." There is no particular emphasis or annotation on any individual bar in the charts.

The figure shows a plot with three sublots. Each subplot is a plot of perplexity against Quantization bits on one of three datasets which from left to right are: WikiText, PTB, and C4. The horizontal axis for each subplot is labeled as "Quantization Bits," with categories in increasing order as 3, 4, 8, and 16 bits. The vertical axis for each subplot is labeled "Perplexity," with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30 on the first and third subplots, and 0 to 400 on the second subplot, with numerical tick intervals of 5 in the first and third subplots, and an interval of 50 in the second subplots. Each subplot shows the perplexity at different quantization bits for two approaches for pruning: Uniform pruning vs the author's DLP Dynamic pruning. Each subplot shows a roughly 25% to 40% decrease in perplexity when comparing uniform pruning vs the authors' pruning method.

The series of bar charts illustrates the perplexity values associated with different quantization bits for three datasets: WikiText, PTB, and C4. Each chart has the horizontal axis labeled as "Quantization Bits," displaying the categories in increasing order as 3, 4, 8, and 16. The vertical axis for each chart is labeled "Perplexity," with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 400 on the second chart and up to 30 on the first and third charts, with numerical tick intervals of 50 and 5 respectively. In each chart, the bars are grouped in pairs for each quantization bit category; the first bar of each pair is labeled "Uniform" and is colored blue, while the second bar is labeled "Ours" and is colored orange. In the WikiText chart, the height of the "Uniform" bars approximately ranges from 25 to 30, whereas the "Ours" bars range from 18 to 22. In the PTB chart, "Uniform" bars span approximately from 300 to 450, while "Ours" bars range from around 170 to 250. In the C4 chart, "Uniform" bars are approximately between 25 and 30, and "Ours" bars range from 18 to 21. In all three charts and for each quantization bit category, the blue bar for "Uniform" is always higher than the orange bar for "Ours." Perplexity generally decreases in all the charts for both "Uniform" and "Ours" as quantization bits increases with the rate of decrease declining with increasing quantization bits.
